subject: english
title: Sentence Polishing · Q3 W11 D03
objective: Use a capital letter and correct end punctuation in a simple sentence.
introduction: Milo is polishing more sentences! ✏️ Begin with a capital letter and end with the right mark.

vocabulary.definition: A telling sentence that gives information and ends with a period.
A question sentence that ends with a question mark.
An exclamation sentence that ends with an exclamation mark.
